assembly_steps.title: Fuselage Primary Framework Assembly
assembly_steps.description: Slot fuselage formers into upper and lower longerons and secure the forward propulsion firewall.

assembly_steps.title: Left Wing Spar and Rib Assembly
assembly_steps.description: Slot wing ribs (RIB-L-000 to RIB-L-009) onto the Main and Rear Wing Spars.

assembly_steps.title: Right Wing Spar and Rib Assembly
assembly_steps.description: Slot wing ribs (RIB-R-000 to RIB-R-009) onto the Main and Rear Wing Spars.

assembly_steps.title: Tail Empennage Assembly
assembly_steps.description: Assemble horizontal stabilizer spars/ribs and vertical stabilizer framework.

assembly_steps.title: Final Airframe Integration & Wing Attachment
assembly_steps.description: Mount left and right wings to the fuselage using the 3D-printed attachment block and align tail empennage.
